thesis: The speakers argue that online advertising is the fundamental business model that drives the entire internet economy, enabling startups to scale from small experiments to major platforms. They contend that while public mistrust regarding data privacy and surveillance capitalism exists, the reality of how targeting works is less nefarious than rumors suggest, and that positive ad experiences often contradict stated user preferences as revealed by high click-through rates.
